title: UpsertAuthority
description: A public-sector body — contracting authority (TED), securities issuer-list publisher (ESMA listings), regulator, etc. Uses a deterministic authority_id (UUID5 over canonical name+country+source). Cross-source matching is the consolidator's job; this event captures one source's view.

national_id.description: National registration number (TED nationalRegistrationNumber, ESMA issuer-list ID, etc.).
